domains.name: Table Transformation Contracts
domains.scope: Preserve observation identity through reversible cell reshaping, positional nested expansion and explicit numeric interval membership.

skills.name: numeric-interval-membership-assignment
skills.description: Assign supplied numeric observations to explicit intervals when endpoint inclusion, gaps or overlapping ranges can make category membership ambiguous.

skills.name: paired-list-positional-expansion
skills.description: Expand paired list columns by their shared position when nested table values represent aligned observations rather than independent combinations.

skills.name: reversible-wide-long-cell-mapping
skills.description: Construct and reverse a wide-to-long table mapping when every original cell must retain its row identity and explicit column identity.
